about: measure contests of 2018 in Idaho, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-id-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

source.name: Idaho Secretary of State: 2018 Idaho Voters' Pamphlet, General Election November 6, 2018 (linked from voteidaho.gov/initiatives-amendments, saved at id_init_amend.html)

ballot_text.source_title: Proposition One: Historical Horse Racing (ballot title: AN INITIATIVE AUTHORIZING HISTORICAL HORSE RACING AT CERTAIN LOCATIONS WHERE LIVE OR SIMULCAST HORSE RACING OCCURS AND ALLOCATING REVENUE THEREFROM)
ballot_text.type_quote: AN INITIATIVE AUTHORIZING HISTORICAL HORSE RACING AT CERTAIN LOCATIONS WHERE LIVE OR SIMULCAST HORSE RACING OCCURS AND ALLOCATING REVENUE THEREFROM.

fact.quote: An initiative amending Chapter 25, Title 54, Idaho Code; contains findings and purposes;
fact.why: The pamphlet calls it an initiative that amends Idaho Code (a statute), and the 'What your vote will do' box says 'A YES vote would approve the proposed law'. It is not a constitutional amendment.

threshold.rule: majority of those voting on the measure (statute; Const. art. III, §1 leaves conditions to the legislature)
threshold.quote: declaring such measures as are approved by a majority of those voted thereon to be in full force and effect as the law of the state of Idaho
threshold.matched: by the type the ballot text states (statute; data/measure/ballot-texts.json)

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (95) for the class 'statewide measure'
